entities.title: No sound
entities.summary: The game has no sound effects or music.
entities.impact: Powers, battles and collapsing homes are shown only on screen.

entities.title: No saved games
entities.summary: A match cannot be saved or resumed; each one is a new island.
entities.impact: Closing the game ends the match.

entities.title: Browser only
entities.summary: The only build is Godot's web export on the Compatibility renderer; there are no desktop downloads.
entities.impact: Players need WebGL 2, a keyboard and a mouse with a right button. Ambient occlusion, which the project asks for, isn't drawn in the browser.
